provenance: Locally authored third holdout for stateful transfer-profile validation; exploratory software evidence only.
evaluation: An interface contract should make numerical assumptions visible to every consumer.
A residual error can be small locally yet alter a later nonlinear decision.
State reset at a sequence boundary prevents one request from contaminating another.
The safest execution plan records both the selected route and the rejected alternatives.
A profile is credible only when its unsupported regions are declared explicitly.
Reproducibility requires the same checkpoint, seed, precision, and held-out inputs.
claim_boundary: Local third-holdout replay only; no physical analog qualification, hardware latency, energy, yield, or authorization claim.
